attendance.unauthorized_absence.employee.title: {stage_label}: unexplained absence, day {run_days}
attendance.unauthorized_absence.employee.body: You have had no attendance and no approved leave since {run_start}, now {run_days} day(s) running as at {date}. This is your {stage_label}. If you were at work, raise a regularisation for the missing punch; if you were on leave, apply for it — either changes this before it escalates further.
attendance.unauthorized_absence.employee.audience_note: The person whose absence it is, told at every stage they cross — not only the first.

attendance.unauthorized_absence.hierarch.title: {stage_label}: {code} has {run_days} unexplained day(s)
attendance.unauthorized_absence.hierarch.body: {code} ({name}) has had no attendance and no approved leave since {run_start}, now {run_days} day(s) running as at {date}. This is their {stage_label}. They have been told directly; this is for you to follow up as their reporting chain.
attendance.unauthorized_absence.hierarch.audience_note: Every member of this employee's OWN reporting chain — their manager, their manager's manager, and so on — unconditionally, never the whole tenant's holders of any designation.

attendance.unauthorized_absence.cc.title: {stage_label}: {code} has {run_days} unexplained day(s)
attendance.unauthorized_absence.cc.body: {code} ({name}) has had no attendance and no approved leave since {run_start}, now {run_days} day(s) running as at {date}. This is their {stage_label}. Copied to you as a standing recipient for the tenant's Unauthorized Absence escalation.
attendance.unauthorized_absence.cc.audience_note: The tenant's default recipients (Company Admin / Branch Admin / HR Admin / HR Manager, or whatever the tenant changed the list to) — company-preferred, tenant-wide only as a fallback.
